checkIn.title: Camera check-in
checkIn.descriptionRequired: This assessment is proctored. Your camera stays on during the attempt and small snapshots are kept for your teacher to review. Allow the camera to continue.
checkIn.descriptionOptional: This assessment is proctored. Your camera stays on during the attempt and small snapshots are kept for your teacher to review.
checkIn.faceOk: Looks good — one face in frame.
checkIn.faceNone: We can't see a face. Face the camera and make sure the room is lit.
checkIn.faceMany: More than one face is in frame. Only you should be visible.
checkIn.noDetector: Make sure your face is clearly visible, then continue.
checkIn.deniedRequired: Camera access was refused. This assessment cannot start without it — allow the camera in your browser settings and try again.
checkIn.deniedOptional: Camera access was refused. You can continue, but the refusal will be noted for your teacher.
checkIn.done: Camera ready. You are set to begin.
checkIn.overrideNote: Still not detected? You can continue — your teacher will check the photo.
